users.description: Users authenticated in the internal messaging platform.
rules: Each user has a unique email.
A user can be ACTIVE or INACTIVE.
Passwords are stored only as secure hashes.
Only channel members can access messages.

channel_members.description: Relationship between users and private channels.
rules: A user can belong to multiple channels.
A channel can have multiple users.
A user cannot be added twice to the same channel.

messages.description: Messages sent by users inside channels.
rules: A message belongs to exactly one channel.
A message has exactly one sender.
Deleted messages are represented through deleted_at.
A user can mark a message as read once.
Read status is associated with a specific user and message.

refresh_tokens.description: Refresh tokens used for JWT session rotation.
rules: Token rotation can reference a replacement token.

first_normal_form: No column contains lists or repeated groups.
Many-to-many relationships are represented through rw_channel_members.
second_normal_form: Non-key attributes depend on the complete primary key.
The composite key of rw_channel_members contains only relationship data.
Message and user attributes are stored in their respective entities.
third_normal_form: Non-key attributes depend only on the primary key.
User information is not duplicated in channels or messages.
Channel information is not duplicated in messages.
Read information is stored independently from messages.
